Name: Custom Farm Types (ABANDONED)
Author: spacechase0
Description:
[color=Red][b][size=5]This mod is no longer maintained and may not work in newer game versions.[/size][/b][/color]


[s]This mod allows adding custom farm types without conflicts or overwriting base game files.

Farm types can customize their behavior to act like one of the vanilla presets in their type.json. If desired, they can also act differently.

To add a new farm type, add a corresponding subfolder in the 'FarmTypes' folder. Each farm type needs an type.json, map.xnb and icon.png.

There are examples of matching vanilla behavior, and "full" customization included. Feel free to remove them if you want.

(NOTE: If you remove the mod, farms will revert back to the 'Standard' farm map until you reinstall the mod. The same applies if you remove an active farm type.)

Requires [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348/?]SpaceCore[/url].[/s]
